summary: Comprehensive backend API testing for unitxt global SMS/WhatsApp platform. All 50 tests pass after fixing 1 bug in registration endpoint.

fixed.issue: MongoDB ObjectId (_id) was not excluded from response, causing JSON serialization error (500)
fixed.fix: Added '_id' to exclusion list in dict comprehension at line 488

critical_code_review_comments: Registration endpoint was returning MongoDB _id which is not JSON serializable - FIXED
All other endpoints properly use clean() helper to exclude _id
CORS is set to allow all origins (*) - acceptable for development but should be restricted in production
Brute force protection implemented with 5 attempts lockout for 15 minutes
JWT tokens properly configured with httpOnly cookies and Bearer token support
seed_data_creation: Seeded automatically on startup: 3 users (admin, reseller, client), 12 countries, 3 providers, 3 pricing plans, 2 promotions (WELCOME10, BONUS25), 2 institutions, 1 approved sender ID (SUNRISE)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend APIs tested and working. Registration bug fixed. Mock SMS provider has 95% success rate (expected behavior). Wallet topup is MOCKED (no real Stripe). Test file covers: auth (login/register/logout/me), wallet (topup with promo codes, transactions), sender-ids, messaging (quick-send, bulk-send, campaigns, stats), contacts (CRUD, import), templates, api-keys, notifications, reseller endpoints, admin endpoints, and RBAC.
mocked_apis_verified: SMS provider send (MockAdapter) - 95% delivery simulation working
Wallet topup - MOCKED, credits wallet directly without Stripe
